status_summary: Executive Order 14162, signed 2025-01-20, directed written notice of withdrawal from the Paris Agreement; the UN depositary notice records the action on 2025-01-27, and the withdrawal took effect on 2026-01-27. A presidential memorandum signed 2026-01-07 and published 2026-01-16 directed withdrawal from 66 organizations, listing the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change among 31 UN entities. The UN depositary recorded the convention withdrawal on 2026-02-27, effective for the United States on 2027-02-27.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14162 directed notice of withdrawal from the Paris Agreement (published 2025-01-30).
The UN depositary recorded the U.S. withdrawal from the Paris Agreement, effective one year later on 2026-01-27.
A presidential memorandum directed withdrawal from 66 international organizations, including the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (published 2026-01-16).
The U.S. withdrawal from the Paris Agreement took effect, on the date stated in the depositary notification.
The UN depositary recorded the U.S. withdrawal from the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, effective 2027-02-27.

title: Withdraw the United States from the Paris Agreement and the UN climate convention
uncertainties: The memorandum date is 2026-01-07 as printed in the Federal Register (published 2026-01-16); news reports dated 2026-01-08 described it a day later. Whether the United States would need Senate action to rejoin the convention is debated and not assessed here. The Mandate places the item in the Treasury chapter, but the actors are the White House and State Department. Related records c00-02 and c06-03 cite the same orders and depositary notices. One search on 2026-10-26 for litigation or reversal found only commentary on the legal debate over the UNFCCC exit and no court order.
